title: Ethernet and IPv4 headers
hints: The version is the high nibble of byte 0 and the header length is the low nibble times 4. Check every length you read against the vector's size before you index with it.
The fragment field is 16 bits: `0x4000` is "don't fragment", `0x2000` is "more fragments", and the low 13 bits are the offset in 8-byte units.
